caption: A half-full fish tank resting on a table is tilted to one side, and the water climbs the low side and spills over the rim.

sa.check: A half-full fish tank rests on a table.
It is tilted to one side.
The water rises on the low side.
The tank is half-full before the tilt.
The tilt comes first, then the climb, then the spill.

pc.expect: The water surface stays level while the tank tilts, so the water piles up at the low side.
pc.fail: The water tilts with the tank keeping a fixed shape; or it climbs the high side; or it rises evenly all round.

pc.expect: The spill comes from the low side only and starts when the rim reaches the surface.
pc.fail: It spills from the high side; or it spills before the rim reaches the water; or it spills while the tank is level.

pc.expect: Spilled water runs down the outside of the tank and onto the table.
pc.fail: The outside stays dry; or water appears on the table with none spilling; or drips rise.

pc.expect: The water sloshes and settles as a liquid, and the tank stays rigid.
pc.fail: The water stays a rigid block; or the glass bends; or the water beads into balls.

pc.expect: One tank, and water leaves it only over the rim.
pc.fail: Water passes through the glass; or the tank duplicates; or the water level rises while spilling.

pc.expect: The tank, its contents and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The water changes colour; or the gravel inside rearranges; or the table changes.
